# Diogo Silva

> Personal website and editorial publication of Diogo Bronze Silva (signing publicly as Diogo Silva). B2B SaaS sales professional based in Portugal (Senior Account Executive at Coverflex), essayist on sales methodology, artificial intelligence at work, philosophy, theology, and family, and documentary photographer under Bronze Art.

The site is hand-written static HTML and CSS: no JavaScript, no analytics, no tracking. Fast, semantic and fully crawlable by both humans and AI models.
Contact: hello@diogobronzesilva.com
Full context document: [llms-full.txt](https://diogobronzesilva.com/llms-full.txt)

## Entity & Professional Profile

- Name: Diogo Bronze Silva (Diogo Silva)
- Current Role: Senior Account Executive at Coverflex (FinTech / employee compensation & benefits)
- Experience: Over a decade in B2B SaaS sales, expansion and customer growth across Portugal, EMEA and UK&I (including Pipedrive through unicorn status, and deskbird through Series B).
- Core Themes: B2B sales methodologies, human decision-making, AI in sales workflows, Catholic social teaching, philosophy, documentary photography.

## Work

- [Work](https://diogobronzesilva.com/work/): Diogo's approach to B2B software sales, decision-making, and AI-native sales workflows.
- Core idea: Sales is conversation.
- Core idea: Good salespeople help people decide. They don't decide for them.
- Core idea: AI should remove the work around the conversation, not the conversation itself.
- Practical AI usage: Account discovery research, pre-call synthesis, CRM and pipeline discipline, identifying decision criteria, and reducing administrative overhead to preserve attention for the client.

## Notes

- [A impossibilidade de separar costumes e economia](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/a-impossibilidade-de-separar-costumes-e-economia/): Em português. Não há economia moralmente neutra: o modo como trabalhamos, compramos, contratamos e lucramos acaba sempre por formar os costumes que dizemos querer proteger. Publicado a 14 de Setembro de 2026.
- [Rumo ao Deserto](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/rumo-ao-deserto/): Em português. Desinvestir do mundo não é abandonar os deveres concretos; é recuperar silêncio, oração e critério numa cultura que pede atenção permanente. Publicado a 7 de Setembro de 2026.
- [Deus e o Belo](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/deus-e-o-belo/): Em português. Se Deus é o próprio Ser, então a beleza não é um adorno religioso: é um sinal da ordem, da verdade e do bem que todas as coisas recebem d'Ele. Publicado a 31 de Agosto de 2026.
- [The ability to leave work](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/the-ability-to-leave-work/): Ambition becomes easier to live with when work is given a proper place, important enough to do well and limited enough to leave behind. Published 24 August 2026.
- [Things parenthood teaches you about people](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/parenthood-teaches-you-about-people/): Parenthood teaches a few things that travel surprisingly well into working life: apologise properly, protect trust and do not punish curiosity for being inconvenient. Published 19 August 2026.
- [What ten years can build](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/what-ten-years-can-build/): Most of what matters is built quietly, through ordinary days repeated long enough to become a life. Published 18 August 2026.
- [Work educates](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/work-educates/): Some kinds of work teach things that explanation cannot: consequence, patience, responsibility and the satisfaction of doing something properly. Published 14 August 2026.
- [Escassez de trabalhadores qualificados](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/escassez-de-trabalhadores-qualificados/): Em português. Porque falta mão de obra qualificada em Portugal: natalidade em quebra, um sistema de ensino desalinhado com a procura real, e uma cultura que tornou o risco de empreender menos atractivo. Publicado a 8 de Julho de 2022.
- [Bitcoin | The Fairy Tale](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/bitcoin-the-fairy-tale/): Why no currency removes the imperfection built into human exchange, because the imperfection was never in the ledger. Published 20 June 2022.
- [Panem et circenses](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/panem-et-circenses/): On the selectivity of online outrage, and why moral performance on social media rewards looking right over being right. Published 25 February 2022.
- [The Reign of Quantities](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/the-reign-of-quantities/): Quality asks for an artisan and time. Quantity asks for neither, which is exactly the trade modern production keeps making. Published 10 December 2021.
- [Efficiency, the One Ring to rule them all](https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/efficiency-the-one-ring/): Efficiency has no natural ceiling. Left to itself it stops serving us and starts being served. Published 22 November 2021.

The Notes index also holds selected podcast and interview appearances under a Podcasts and Live Interviews section. These are treated as part of Diogo's intellectual and editorial work rather than as professional credentials. The RSS feed remains limited to published written notes.
